# Jordan Lee

Jordan Lee is an experienced operations coordinator who has worked in service businesses and construction offices. Jordan communicates with customers, organizes schedules, prepares reports, checks invoices, and supports teams. Jordan is reliable and learns systems quickly.

At Northline Services, Jordan coordinates field staff and helps customers understand delays. Before that, Jordan worked at Harbor Works, where Jordan maintained records and spoke with suppliers. Jordan completed a certificate in business administration and is now seeking a new opportunity.
